bash "$(dirname -- "$(readlink -f /run/system-configuration.json)")/user-configuration.sh" --run modules/system/performance/gravity-mark '#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
version=1.89
checksum=de090c7b9e40f10f225d9393f2cf73a660ad4edc21f6b333eea3190a8722e005
target=/opt/gravity-mark/GravityMark.run
# Compare the installed payload itself; no version/state manifest is needed.
if [[ -f $target ]] && printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' "$checksum" "$target" | sha256sum --check --status; then
    exit 0
fi
temporary=$(mktemp -d)
trap '"'"'rm -rf -- "$temporary"'"'"' EXIT
curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --retry 3 \
    --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 600 \
    "https://tellusim.com/download/GravityMark_$version.run" \
    --output "$temporary/GravityMark.run"
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' "$checksum" "$temporary/GravityMark.run" | sha256sum --check --status
install -Dm0755 "$temporary/GravityMark.run" "$target"
'

bash "$(dirname -- "$(readlink -f /run/system-configuration.json)")/user-configuration.sh" --run modules/browsers/chromium '#!/usr/bin/env bash
## Chromium and Chrome-compatible browser setup
## https://www.chromium.org/Home/
## https://www.google.com/chrome/
set -Eeuo pipefail
repo_dir=${DOTFILES_REPO:?}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Atomic config writes; HOME is a staging directory during system setup.
file_write() {
    local mode=0644 destination temporary
    if [[ ${1:-} == -m ]]; then mode=$2; shift 2; fi
    destination=${1:?Destination required}
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$destination")"
    temporary=$(mktemp "${destination}.tmp.XXXXXX")
    cat > "$temporary"
    chmod "$mode" "$temporary"
    mv -Tf -- "$temporary" "$destination"

}
file_append() {
    local destination=${1:?Destination required}
    { [[ ! -f $destination ]] || cat -- "$destination"; cat; } | file_write "$destination"
}
home_link() {
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$2")"
    ln -sfnT -- "$1" "$2"
}

chromium_install_extensions() {
	local browsers_config=$1 url extension_id
	local entries=()

	while IFS= read -r url; do
		[[ -n $url ]] || continue
		if [[ $url =~ /detail/[^/]+/([a-zA-Z]+)/?$ ]]; then
			extension_id=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
		else
			printf '"'"'Could not extract Chromium extension ID from %s\n'"'"' "$url" >&2
			return 1
		fi
		entries+=("$extension_id;https://clients2.google.com/service/update2/crx")
	done < <(jq -r '"'"'.extensions[]'"'"' <<<"$browsers_config")

	printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${entries[@]}" |
		jq -R -s '"'"'{ExtensionInstallForcelist: (split("\n") | map(select(length > 0)))}'"'"' |
		file_write /etc/chromium/policies/managed/ported-extensions.json
}



configure() {
	BROWSERS_CONFIG=$(jq -c '"'"'.extra.browsers.chromium'"'"' /run/system-configuration.json)

	chromium_install_extensions "$BROWSERS_CONFIG"
    jq '"'"'{WebAppInstallForceList: (.web_apps // [])}'"'"' <<<"$BROWSERS_CONFIG" |
        file_write /etc/chromium/policies/managed/web-apps.json
	# Keep Chrome clean (no extensions)
}

configure
'

#!/usr/bin/env bash

cpu_vendor_is() {
	local wanted=${1:?CPU vendor required}
	awk -F: -v wanted="$wanted" '"'"'
		/vendor_id/ {
			gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", $2)
			exit($2 == wanted ? 0 : 1)
		}
		END { if (NR == 0) exit 1 }
	'"'"' /proc/cpuinfo
}

pci_vendor_present() {
	local wanted=${1:?PCI vendor ID required} vendor
	for vendor in /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/vendor; do
		[[ -r $vendor ]] || continue
		[[ $(<"$vendor") == "$wanted" ]] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

dmi_matches() {
	local pattern=${1:?DMI pattern required} value file
	for file in /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name; do
		[[ -r $file ]] || continue
		value=$(<"$file")
		[[ ${value,,} == *${pattern,,}* ]] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

usb_vendor_present() {
	local wanted=${1:?USB vendor ID required} vendor
	for vendor in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor; do
		[[ -r $vendor ]] || continue
		[[ ${wanted,,} == $(tr '"'"'[:upper:]'"'"' '"'"'[:lower:]'"'"' <"$vendor") ]] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

# Configuration
SHADERS_DIR="${MPV_SHADERS_DIR:-/usr/share/mpv-shim-default-shaders/shaders}"
PACK_JSON="${MPV_SHADER_PACK:-/usr/share/mpv-shim-default-shaders/pack-next.json}"
MPV_CONF_DIR="$HOME/.config/mpv"

configure() {
	# Physical GA402RK comparisons found VA-API/OpenGL substantially cheaper
	# than Vulkan Video for the tested H.264 playback. Keep driver/codec discovery
	# automatic; this is a native mpv option, not a power-management hook.
	if dmi_matches ga402rk; then
		file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf" <<'"'"'EOF'"'"'
# GA402RK playback renderer preference
gpu-api=opengl

EOF
	fi
	# Package-owned shader and plugin payloads provide pack-next.json before this
	# configuration phase begins.
	[[ -f $PACK_JSON ]] || {
		printf '"'"'MPV extras package did not install %s\n'"'"' "$PACK_JSON" >&2
		return 1
	}

	# Generate mpv profile sections from upstream pack-next.json
	file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf" <<'"'"'HEADER'"'"'
# Auto-generated from https://github.com/iwalton3/default-shader-pack/blob/master/pack-next.json
HEADER
	jq -r --arg sd "${SHADERS_DIR}" '"'"'
    .["setting-groups"] as $g |
    .profiles | to_entries[] |
    .key as $n | .value as $p |
    ($p["setting-groups"] // []) as $sgs |
    ([($sgs[] | $g[.].shaders // [] | .[])] + ($p.shaders // [])) as $shaders |
    [($sgs[] | $g[.].settings // [] | .[])] as $settings |
    "[\($n)]",
    ($settings[] |
        "\(.[0] | gsub("_"; "-"))=\(
            if .[1] == true then "yes"
            elif .[1] == false then "no"
            else .[1] | tostring
            end
        )"
    ),
    ($shaders | to_entries[] |
        if .key == 0 then "glsl-shaders=\($sd)/\(.value)"
        else "glsl-shaders-append=\($sd)/\(.value)"
        end
    ),
    ""
'"'"' "${PACK_JSON}" | file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf"

	# Convenience aliases for long profile names
	file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf" <<'"'"'EOF'"'"'
[fsr]
profile=AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution

[cas]
profile=AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening

EOF

	# Custom combo profile (not in upstream shader pack)
	file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf" <<EOF
[fsr-cas]
glsl-shaders=${SHADERS_DIR}/FSR.glsl
glsl-shaders-append=${SHADERS_DIR}/CAS-scaled.glsl
EOF

	# The owner selected generic-high as the default; preserve all other profiles.
	jq -e '"'"'.profiles | has("generic-high")'"'"' "$PACK_JSON" >/dev/null || {
		printf '"'"'Shader pack is missing the requested generic-high profile.\n'"'"' >&2
		return 1
	}
	file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/mpv.conf" <<'"'"'EOF'"'"'

[default]
profile=generic-high

EOF

	# Generate input.conf menu entries for profiles without manual keybindings
	BOUND_PROFILES="fsr-cas generic-high nnedi-very-high anime4k-high-a anime4k-high-b anime4k-high-c anime4k-high-aa anime4k-high-bb anime4k-high-ca"
	jq -r --arg skip "$BOUND_PROFILES" '"'"'
    ($skip | split(" ")) as $skip_list |
    .profiles | to_entries[] |
    select(.key as $k | $skip_list | index($k) | not) |
    "# apply-profile \"\(.key)\"; show-text \"Profile: \(.value.displayname // .key)\" #! Profiles > \(.value.displayname // .key)"
'"'"' "${PACK_JSON}" | file_append "${MPV_CONF_DIR}/input.conf"
}

configure
'

bash "$(dirname -- "$(readlink -f /run/system-configuration.json)")/user-configuration.sh" --run modules/system/boot '#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
# Archinstall generates the device-specific command line and UKI presets.
# Adapt its password-based encryption parameters to systemd early userspace.
jq -e '"'"'.bootloader_config | .bootloader == "Efistub" and .uki == true'"'"' \
    /run/system-configuration.json >/dev/null || {
    echo '"'"'Boot configuration requires EFI stub boot with UKIs.'"'"' >&2; exit 1;
}
python3 - /etc/kernel/cmdline /etc/mkinitcpio.d <<'"'"'PY_BOOT'"'"'
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import sys
import tempfile

cmdline, presets = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
# Explicit preset configs bypass mkinitcpio.conf.d and would ignore our hooks.
active_presets = list(presets.glob('"'"'*.preset'"'"'))
if not active_presets or not any(re.search(r'"'"'^\w+_uki='"'"', p.read_text(), re.M) for p in active_presets):
    sys.exit('"'"'No UKI preset found; configure UKIs before applying boot settings.'"'"')
if any(re.search(r'"'"'^\s*\w+_config='"'"', p.read_text(), re.M) for p in active_presets):
    sys.exit('"'"'Remove explicit *_config settings from mkinitcpio presets to enable drop-ins.'"'"')

parameters = cmdline.read_text().split()
if not any(p.startswith('"'"'root='"'"') for p in parameters):
    sys.exit('"'"'Kernel command line has no root device.'"'"')
quiet = {
    '"'"'quiet'"'"': '"'"'quiet'"'"',
    '"'"'loglevel'"'"': '"'"'loglevel=3'"'"',
    '"'"'systemd.show_status'"'"': '"'"'systemd.show_status=auto'"'"',
    '"'"'rd.systemd.show_status'"'"': '"'"'rd.systemd.show_status=auto'"'"',
    '"'"'udev.log_level'"'"': '"'"'udev.log_level=3'"'"',
    '"'"'rd.udev.log_level'"'"': '"'"'rd.udev.log_level=3'"'"',
    '"'"'vt.global_cursor_default'"'"': '"'"'vt.global_cursor_default=0'"'"',
}
result = []
for parameter in parameters:
    if parameter.startswith('"'"'cryptdevice='"'"'):
        match = re.fullmatch(r'"'"'cryptdevice=UUID=([0-9a-fA-F-]{36}):([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)'"'"', parameter)
        if not match:
            sys.exit(f'"'"'Unsupported archinstall encryption parameter: {parameter}'"'"')
        parameter = f'"'"'rd.luks.name={match[1]}={match[2]}'"'"'
    if parameter.split('"'"'='"'"', 1)[0] not in quiet:
        result.append(parameter)
result.extend(quiet.values())
# Do not replace the active command line until all checks have passed.
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='"'"'w'"'"', dir=cmdline.parent, delete=False) as temporary:
    target = Path(temporary.name)
    try:
        temporary.write('"'"' '"'"'.join(result) + '"'"'\n'"'"')
        temporary.close()
        os.chmod(target, 0o644)
        target.replace(cmdline)
    finally:
        target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
PY_BOOT
# Rebuild the UKIs with the updated command line and systemd hooks.
mkinitcpio -P
'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
# Select mirrors on the ISO; the target inherits this list through pacstrap.
# The installed system refreshes its list through reflector.timer.
[[ ${CONFIG_MODE:-install} == install && -d /run/archiso ]] || exit 0
reflector @"${MODULE_DIR:?}/files/etc/xdg/reflector/reflector.conf"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
# Prepare trust before native repository transactions, on both ISO and target.
pacman-key --init
for key in \
    F79100EF8C802DAB81C323BB8EEA5962FE510E19 \
    8F654886F17D497FEFE3DB448B15A6B0E9A3FA35 \
    3056513887B78AEB; do
    if ! pacman-key --list-keys "$key" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        pacman-key --recv-keys "$key" --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com
    fi
    pacman-key --lsign-key "$key"
done
if ! pacman -Q chaotic-keyring chaotic-mirrorlist >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pacman -U --needed --noconfirm -- \
        https://cdn-mirror.chaotic.cx/chaotic-aur/chaotic-keyring.pkg.tar.zst \
        https://cdn-mirror.chaotic.cx/chaotic-aur/chaotic-mirrorlist.pkg.tar.zst
fi
pacman-key --populate chaotic
